title: Meet.bot MCP
description: AI-native scheduling and booking: check availability, book meetings, share links.
summary: AI-native scheduling and booking: check availability, book meetings, share links.
offersHint: AI-native scheduling and booking: check availability, book meetings, share links. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.meet.bot · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Meet.bot API key. Format: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Your Meet.bot API key. Format: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

toolsPreview.name: get_scheduling_pages
toolsPreview.description: Get all scheduling pages for the authenticated user

toolsPreview.name: get_page_info
toolsPreview.description: Get information about a specific scheduling page

toolsPreview.name: get_available_slots
toolsPreview.description: Get available booking slots for a scheduling page

toolsPreview.name: health_check
toolsPreview.description: Check if the Meet.bot API client is healthy and the Bearer token is valid

toolsPreview.name: list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: List the authenticated user's outbound booking webhooks (fired on booking_received, booking_rescheduled and booking_cancelled)

toolsPreview.name: set_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Create or update an outbound booking webhook. Omit id to create (webhook_url required); pass id to update. Meet.bot POSTs a JWT-signed (HS256) JSON payload to the URL on each booking event.

toolsPreview.name: delete_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Delete one of the authenticated user's webhooks by id
